metadata.title: SSPP – Secure Time Platform
metadata.remarks: System Security & Privacy Plan template asserting institutional requirements for authoritative, resilient, and defensible platform time and its correct interpretation by cryptographic consumers.

import-profile.remarks: Imports institutional baseline security and governance requirements applicable to all platform services.

system-characteristics.system-description: Authoritative platform time service supporting authentication, cryptographic validity, auditing, detection, forensics, and policy enforcement across the institutional environment.

props.name: platform-capability
props.remarks: This system asserts the Secure Time composite trust pattern.

props.name: time-governance-scope
props.remarks: Time is provided as a governed platform dependency and consumed by higher-level trust planes.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP asserts Secure Time by composition of platform time patterns. It defines no independent controls; compliance is achieved through satisfaction of referenced patterns.

components.title: Secure Time (Composite Assertion)
components.description: Composite assertion that platform time is authoritative, bounded, observable, resilient, and correctly interpreted for cryptographic validity.

roles.title: Time Governance Authority
roles.remarks: Defines institutional posture for authoritative time, acceptable skew, resilience requirements, and risk tolerance.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Executive Cyber Leadership per NIST NICE Framework (SP 800-181).

roles.title: Platform Time Architect
roles.remarks: Designs time architecture, dependency relationships, and integration with cryptographic and security services.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Architect per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: Platform Time Operations
roles.remarks: Operates authoritative time sources, synchronization services, and resilience mechanisms.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Systems Administrator per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: Time Monitoring and Assurance
roles.remarks: Monitors time drift, synchronization health, anomalies, and supports incident response and forensics.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Operations Analyst per NIST NICE Framework.

control-implementation.remarks: Control satisfaction is achieved through inherited control implementations in Secure Time constituent patterns. This SSPP introduces no standalone controls or compensating measures.
